spans.s:
लुश लुश, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi with the
patronymic Dhānāka (author of the hymns Ṛg-veda
लुशाकपि लुशाकपि, इस्, m. a proper N.

लुष् लुष् [cf. rt. लूष्], cl. 1. P. लोषति,
&c., to rob, plunder.

लूष् लूष् [cf. rts. लुष्, रूष्], cl. 1. P. लू-
षति, &c., to adorn, decorate; cl. 10. P.
लूषयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अलूलुषत्, to hurt, injure,
kill; to rob, steal, (also cl. 1. P. लोषति.)

लुषभ लुषभ, अस्, m. (according to
Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt. 1. रुष्), an elephant in
rut; [cf. Gr. λύσσα.]
